description: NaCaTiFe₃O₈ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pmn2₁ space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.63 Å. Ca is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.59 Å. Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with four FeO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent FeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 49-55°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.93-2.07 Å. There are three inequivalent Fe sites. In the first Fe site, Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent FeO₆ octahedra, and edges with four FeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 49-55°. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 2.01-2.10 Å. In the second Fe site, Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent FeO₆ octahedra, and edges with four FeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 49-59°. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 2.01-2.13 Å. In the third Fe site, Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with four FeO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent FeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 49-59°. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.99-2.11 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Ti, and one Fe atom to form distorted ONa₂Ti₂Fe square pyramids that share corners with three ONa₂Fe₃ trigonal bipyramids, edges with four ONa₂Ti₂Fe square pyramids, and edges with three ONaCaFe₃ trigonal bipyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Ca, one Ti, and two equivalent Fe atoms to form distorted OCa₂TiFe₂ square pyramids that share corners with ten ONaCaFe₃ trigonal bipyramids, edges with four ONa₂Ti₂Fe square pyramids, and edges with three ONaCaFe₃ trigonal bipyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, two equivalent Ti, and one Fe atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Ca, and three Fe atoms to form distorted ONaCaFe₃ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four equivalent OCa₂TiFe₂ square pyramids, corners with five ONaCaFe₃ trigonal bipyramids, edges with three ONa₂Ti₂Fe square pyramids, and edges with four OCa₂Fe₃ trigonal bipyramids. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and three Fe atoms to form distorted ONa₂Fe₃ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₂Ti₂Fe square pyramids, corners with five ONaCaFe₃ trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₂Ti₂Fe square pyramid, and edges with five ONa₂Fe₃ trigonal bipyramids. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Ca and three Fe atoms to form distorted OCa₂Fe₃ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent OCa₂TiFe₂ square pyramids, corners with four equivalent OCa₂Fe₃ trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one OCa₂TiFe₂ square pyramid, and edges with seven ONaCaFe₃ trigonal bipyramids. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ti, and two equivalent Fe atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Ca and three Fe atoms to form distorted OCa₂Fe₃ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with five ONa₂Ti₂Fe square pyramids, corners with six ONa₂Fe₃ trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one OCa₂TiFe₂ square pyramid, and edges with six ONaCaFe₃ trigonal bipyramids.
